column5: With one-sided noncompliance, assignment (treat) moves outcomes only through the subset that actually receives. ITT averages the effect over everyone assigned, including those who do not receive, so it is attenuated toward zero. TOT/LATE rescales by the take-up (first stage), recovering the effect among compliers, so it is typically larger in magnitude.
